newsitem.title: HUNGARY: KEKKUTI SUBSCRIPTION PRICE SET AT 1,280 FORINTS.
newsitem.headline: KEKKUTI SUBSCRIPTION PRICE SET AT 1,280 FORINTS.

text.p: The subscription price of shares in Hungarian mineral water bottler and distributor Kekkuti Asvanyviz Rt was set at 1,280 forints, Hungary's state securities and exchange supervision said in a statement.

The company will publicly offer 23,260 series A registered shares with a face value of 100 forints, it said in the official bourse gazette. The amount to be offered publicly represents one percent of Kekkuti's series A shares.
Subscription will run from November 19 to 21. In case of oversubscription the lead manager Postabank Securities may close subscriptions earlier.
The Budapest Stock Exchange gave its conditional approval for the listing of the shares last week.
